mapper.select: SELECT * FROM callbackinboxpartition WHERE id IN #{id} ORDER BY id FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM callbackinbox WHERE receipt_key IN #{key}

SELECT r.* FROM callbackinbox r WHERE r.state='pending' AND r.available_at<=#{now} AND r.kind='telephony_status' AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(r.body_json,'$.payload.status')) IN ('dialing','answered') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM callbackinbox older WHERE older.call_id=r.call_id AND older.id<r.id AND older.state<>'done') ORDER BY r.id LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT * FROM callbackinbox FORCE INDEX(PRIMARY) WHERE id IN #{id} ORDER BY id FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM callusage WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND call_session_id IN #{id}
SELECT e.* FROM webhookeventingest e JOIN callsession c ON c.id=e.call_session_id WHERE c.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND c.id IN #{id}
SELECT * FROM taskoutbox WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND aggregate_id IN #{id}
SELECT * FROM taskreceipt WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND aggregate_id IN #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE callbackinbox FORCE INDEX(PRIMARY) SET state='done',completed_at=#{now},error_type='' WHERE state='pending' AND id IN #{id}

UPDATE callbackinboxpartition SET pending_count=pending_count+CASE id WHEN #{d.id} THEN #{d.count} ELSE 0 END,pending_bytes=pending_bytes+CASE id WHEN #{d.id} THEN #{d.bytes} ELSE 0 END WHERE id IN #{d.id}
